data.name: Elavarasan
data.gender_notes: Elavarasan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Elavarasan is a Tamil name derived from Elavar, the deity of liberation. The name is composed of three parts: Ela (liberation), vara (boon), and san (protection). Thus, Elavarasan means 'the one who grants liberation and protection'. The name Elavarasan carries the meaning “God of Liberation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Elavarasan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of liberation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the attainment of Moksha (liberation from the cycle of birth and death)
data.etymology: Elavarasan belongs to the Tamil linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Liberation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elavarasan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: Elavarasan is a Hindu name deeply rooted in Tamil culture, particularly in the regions of Tamil Nadu, India. The name reflects the spiritual beliefs and devotion found in Hinduism, specifically to the deity Elavar or Aiyanar, the protective god of the hearth and village. Honoring the name Elavarasan means acknowledging the cultural significance of protection and liberation in daily life and spiritual pursuits.
data.spiritual_significance: Elavarasan represents the profound spiritual beliefs of Hindus, emphasizing protection, liberation, and devotion. The name Elavarasan itself is believed to convey divine blessings and protection. As a faithful devotee of Elavar, Elavarasan embodies the hope for attaining spiritual growth, compassion, and the ultimate goal of moksha or liberation from the continuing cycle of birth, death, and rebirth. While fulfilling wordly duties and obligations, Elavarasan strives to nurture inner peace, self-reflection, and the pursuit of wisdom and devotion towards the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Elavarasan: God of Compassion and Grace. The name signifies the one who bestows blessings and mercy upon devotees, eliminating their sufferings.
